en.title: Largest Team Satisfying Limits on Lower- and Higher-Skilled Members
en.description:
Developer i has skill i (1-based). If selected, developer i requires that at most lower[i] team members have lower skill and at most higher[i] have higher skill. Find the largest team in which everyone's requirements are satisfied.

The input/output protocol was compiled by this site; missing numeric bounds and recoveries of source typos are all stated explicitly.
en.input: The first line contains n, the second line contains lower, and the third line contains higher; 0≤array values<n. The original OCR025 states n≤200000 and 026 states n≤2000000; this site keeps the wider original domain 1≤n≤2000000 and does not narrow it to the 200,000 of the curated page.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 3; 3; 1. These answers were verified by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Binary search on the team size K and scan from low skill to high skill: when c people have been selected, select this person if lower≥c and higher≥K−1−c. Use compact 32-bit arrays and token-by-token parsing to cover the 2,000,000 domain.
